{{av}}

'''Skin''' is a tissue layer common to most [[cv:creature|creature]]s. Different types of creatures have different types of skin.
* Most mundane creatures have raw hide, which displays in-game as '''skin'''. This is the only type that can be tanned into [[leather]].
* Insectoids creatures have [[Chitin]].
* Reptilian creatures and fish generally have [[scale|Scales]].

All skin types are stored in a refuse stockpile (both fresh and rotten).

== Skin uses ==
Raw skin, Chitin and Scales can be processed at a [[Tanner]] by a dwarf with the [[cv:Tanning|Tanning]] labor enabled in order to produce Leather, Chitin and Scale respectivly. If skins are not tanned automatically, try using your [[cv:manager|manager]] to manually queue "Tan a Hide" jobs.
